G0518.def:
**ἀπ-αγγέλλω **
[in LXX chiefly for נָגַד hi. ;]
**of a messenger, speaker, or writer, to report, announce, declare**: with accusative of thing(s), [[Act.4.23|Act.4:23]], al.; with dative of person(s), [[Mat.2.8|Mat.2:8]], al.; before ὃτι, [[Luk.18.37|Luk.18:37]] πῶς, [[Luk.8.36|Luk.8:36]] περί, [[Luk.7.18; 13.1|Luk.7:18 13:1]], [[Act.28.21|Act.28:21]], [[1Th.1.9|1Th.1:9]]; λέγων, [[Act.22.26|Act.22:26]] with accusative and inf., [[Act.12.14|Act.12:14]] before εἰς, [[Mrk.5.14|Mrk.5:14]], [[Luk.8.34|Luk.8:34]] (MM, _VGT_, see word; Cremer, 25)
(AS)

G0565.def:
**ἀπέρχομαι**,
[in LXX chiefly for הלךְ ;]
1. **to go away, depart** (also, in late writers, with "perfective" force, **to arrive** at a destination, the thought being carried on to the goal; M, _Pr._, 111f., 247; MM, see word);
(a) absol.: [[Mat.13.25|Mat.13:25]], al.; ptcp., ἀπελθών, used pleonastically with other verbs as in Heb. (Dalman, _Words_, 21), [[Mat.13.28|Mat.13:28]], al.;
(b) **with mention of place or person**: εἰς, [[Mat.14.15|Mat.14:15]] ἐπί, [[Luk.24.24|Luk.24:24]] πρός, [[Rev.10.9|Rev.10:9]] ἀπό, [[Luk.1.38|Luk.1:38]] ἐξω, [[Act.4.15|Act.4:15]] ἐκεῖ, [[Mat.2.22|Mat.2:22]]
2. As in LXX, before ὀπίσω, with genitive (Heb. הָלַךְ אַחֲרֵי), **to go after, follow**: [[Mrk.1.20|Mrk.1:20]], [[Jhn.12.19|Jhn.12:19]]; metaphorically, [[Mrk.1.42|Mrk.1:42]], [[Rev.21.1|Rev.21:1]].
(AS)

G0513.def:
**αξίνη**, -ης, ἡ
[in LXX for גַּרְזֶן, קַרְדֹּם ;]
**an axe**: [[Mat.3.10|Mat.3:10]], [[Luk.3.9|Luk.3:9]].†
(AS)

G0596.def:
**ἀπο-θήκη**, -ης, ἡ
(ἀποτίθημι), [in LXX for אוֹצָר, טֶנֶא, etc. ;]
**a storehouse, granary**: [[Mat.3.12; 6.26; 13.30|Mat.3:12 6:26 13:30]], [[Luk.3.17; 12.18, 24|Luk.3:17 12:18, 24]].†
(AS)

G0591.def:
**ἀπο-δίδωμι **
[in LXX for מָכַר, שׁוּב hi., נָתַן, שָׁלֵם pi., etc. ;]
**to give up or back, restore, return**: [[Mat.27.58|Mat.27:58]], [[Luk.4.20; 9.42; 19.8|Luk.4:20 9:42 19:8]]; esp. of wages, debts, oaths, etc. (MM, see word), **to render what is due, to pay **(Deiss., _LAE_, 334 f.): absol., [[Mat.18.25, 28|Mat.18:25, 28]], [[Luk.7.42|Luk.7:42]]. with accusative, [[Mat.5.26; 18.29-30, 34; 20.8; 21.41; 22.21|Mat.5:26 18:29-30, 34 20:8 21:41 22:21]], [[Mrk.12.17|Mrk.12:17]], [[Luk.10.35; 12.59; 20.25|Luk.10:35 12:59 20:25]], [[Rom.13.7|Rom.13:7]], [[Heb.12.11|Heb.12:11]], [[Rev.22.2|Rev.22:2]]; ὅρκους, [[Mat.5.33|Mat.5:33]] (cf. [[Num.30.3|Num.30:3]], [[Deu.23.21|Deu.23:21]] al.); of conjugal duty, τ. ὀφειλήν, [[1Co.7.3|1Co.7:3]] ἀμοιβάς, [[1Ti.5.4|1Ti.5:4]] μαρτύριον, to give (as in duty bound) testimony, [[Act.4.33|Act.4:33]] λόγον, to render account, [[Mat.12.36|Mat.12:36]], [[Luk.16.2|Luk.16:2]], [[Act.19.40|Act.19:40]], [[Heb.13.17|Heb.13:17]], [[1Pe.4.5|1Pe.4:5]]; hence of requital, recompense, both in good and bad sense, [[Mat.6.4, 6; 6.18; 16.27|Mat.6:4, 6 6:18 16:27]], [[Rom.2.6|Rom.2:6]], [[2Ti.4.8; 4.14|2Ti.4:8 4:14]] [[Rev.18.6; 22.12|Rev.18:6 22:12]]; κακὸν ἀντὶ κακοῦ, [[Rom.12.17|Rom.12:17]], [[1Th.5.15|1Th.5:15]], [[1Pe.3.9|1Pe.3:9]]. Mid., to give up of one's own, hence** to sell **(fr. Hdt. on): with accusative of thing(s), [[Act.5.8|Act.5:8]], [[Heb.12.16|Heb.12:16]]; with accusative of person(s), [[Act.7.9|Act.7:9]] (cf. ἀνταποδίδωμι) .†
(AS)

G0568.def:
**ἀπ-έχω **
[in LXX chiefly for רָחַק ;]
1. trans.,
(a) **to hold back, keep off**;
(b) **to have in full, to have received **(on the " punctiliar " force of the compound, see M, _Pr._, 109, 247): with accusative, [[Mat.6.2, 5; 6.16|Mat.6:2, 5 6:16]], [[Luk.6.24|Luk.6:24]], [[Php.4.18|Php.4:18]], Phm 15 (for illustr. from π., where it is used in receipts, see Deiss., BS, 229; _LAE_, 110 f.; MM, see word); impers., ἀπέχει (Field, _Notes_, 39), **it is enough**: [[Mrk.14.41|Mrk.14:41]]
2. Intrans., **to be away, distant**: absol., [[Luk.15.20|Luk.15:20]] before ἀπό, [[Mat.14.24; 15.8|Mat.14:24 15:8]], [[Mrk.7.6|Mrk.7:6]], [[Luk.7.6; 15.20; 24.13|Luk.7:6 15:20 24:13]]. Mid., **to abstain**: with genitive, [[Act.15.29|Act.15:29]], [[1Ti.4.3|1Ti.4:3]], [[1Pe.2.11|1Pe.2:11]]; before ἀπό, [[Act.15.20|Act.15:20]], [[1Th.4.3; 5.22|1Th.4:3 5:22]].†
(AS)

G0573.def:
**ἁπλοῦς**, -ῆ, -οῦν
(contr. fr. -όος; ἁ.- cop., πλόος), [in LXX: [[Pro.11.25|Pro.11:25]] * ;]
**simple, single**: in a moral sense (_DCG_, ii, 628 f.), ἀφθαλμός, [[Mat.6.22|Mat.6:22]], [[Luk.11.34|Luk.11:34]]. (In π. of a marriage dowry, see MM, see word).†
ἁπλόος, see: ἁπλοῦς
_SYN._: ἄδολος, ἄκακος, ἀκέραιος (Tr., _Syn._, § lvi; Cremer, 107, 639) (AS)

G0537.def:
**ἅπας**, -ασα, -αν
(strengthened form of πᾶς, see: ἅ-),
**all, the whole, altogether**: bef. subst. with art., as [[Luk.3.21|Luk.3:21]] or after, as [[Mrk.16.15|Mrk.16:15]]]; absol., in masc., as [[Luk.5.26|Luk.5:26]] in neut., as [[Act.2.44|Act.2:44]] ἅ. οὗτοι, [[Act.2.7|Act.2:7]] (LT); ἅ. ὑμεῖς, [[Gal.3.28|Gal.3:28]] (TTr.). Most frequently in Lk, Ac (see MM, _VGT_, see word)
(AS)

G0520.def:
**ἀπ-άγω **
[in LXX for נָהַג, הָלַךְ hi., etc. ;]
**to lead away**: [[Luk.13.15|Luk.13:15]], [[Act.23.17; 24.7|Act.23:17 24:7]] (R, mg.), [[1Co.12.2|1Co.12:2]] esp. of leading to trial (so as law term in Attic), **prison and death **(MM, _VGT_, see word): [[Mat.26.57; 27.2, 31|Mat.26:57 27:2, 31]], [[Mrk.14.44, 53; 15.16|Mrk.14:44, 53 15:16]], [[Luk.21.12; 22.66; 23.26|Luk.21:12 22:66 23:26]], [[Act.12.19|Act.12:19]]; of the direction of a way: [[Mat.7.13-14|Mat.7:13-14]] (cf. συν-απ-άγω).†
(AS)

G0599.def:
**ἀπο-θνῄσκω**,
[in LXX chiefly for מוּת ;]
**to die**: of natural death, [[Mrk.5.35|Mrk.5:35]], al.; of violent death (pass. of ἀποκτείνω), esp. of Christ, [[Mat.26.35|Mat.26:35]], [[Jhn.12.33|Jhn.12:33]], [[Heb.10.28|Heb.10:28]], al.; of spiritual death, [[Jhn.6.50|Jhn.6:50]], [[Rom.8.13|Rom.8:13]], al.; with dative ref., [[Rom.6.2, 10; 14.7, 8|Rom.6:2, 10 14:7, 8]], [[Gal.2.19|Gal.2:19]]; accusative, ὅ, [[Rom.6.10|Rom.6:10]] before ἐν, [[Mat.8.32|Mat.8:32]], [[Jhn.8.21, 24|Jhn.8:21, 24]] [[1Co.15.22|1Co.15:22]], [[Heb.11.37|Heb.11:37]], [[Rev.14.13|Rev.14:13]]; before ὑπέρ, περί, [[Jhn.11.50, 51; 18.14|Jhn.11:50, 51 18:14]], [[Rom.5.6-8; 14.15|Rom.5:6-8 14:15]], [[1Co.15.3|1Co.15:3]], [[2Co.5.15|2Co.5:15]], [[1Th.5.10|1Th.5:10]], [[1Pe.3.18|1Pe.3:18]]; ἀπό, [[Col.2.20|Col.2:20]] ἐκ, [[Rev.8.11|Rev.8:11]] figuratively, [[1Co.15.31|1Co.15:31]] (cf. συν-αποθνήσκω, and V. Milligan, _NTD_, 258f.; _DCG_, i, 791b; Cremer, 286; MM, see word; on the perfective force of this verb, M, _Pr._, 112, 114; and on the distinction bet. present and aor., ib. 113 f.).
(AS)

G0522.def:
**ἀπ-αίρω **
[in LXX chiefly for נָסַע ;]
**to lift off**, hence, **to take away**; pass.: [[Mat.9.15|Mat.9:15]], [[Mrk.2.20|Mrk.2:20]], [[Luk.5.35|Luk.5:35]].†
(AS)

G0504.def:
**ἄνυδρος**, -ον
(ἀ- neg., ὕδωρ) [in LXX for צִיָּה, יְשִׁימוֹן (γῆ ἄ), etc. ;]
**waterless**: τόποι, [[Mat.12.43|Mat.12:43]], [[Luk.11.24|Luk.11:24]]; πηγαί, [[2Pe.2.17|2Pe.2:17]] νεφέλαι, [[Jude.12|Ju 12]] (MM, _VGT_, see word).†
(AS)

G0539.def:
**ἀπάτη**, -ης, ἡ
[in LXX: [[Ecc.9.6|Ecc.9:6]] א (no _Heb._ equiv.), [[Jdt.9.3, 10; 9.13; 16.8|Jdth.9:3, 10 9:13 16:8]], [[4Ma.18.8|4Ma.18:8]] * ;]
**deceit, deceitfulness**: [[Col.2.8|Col.2:8]] τοῦ πλούτου, [[Mat.13.22|Mat.13:22]], [[Mrk.4.19|Mrk.4:19]] (MM, _VGT_, see word); τῆς ἀδικίας, [[2Th.2.10|2Th.2:10]] τῆς ἁμαρτίας, [[Heb.3.13|Heb.3:13]] αἱ ἐπιθυμίαι τῆς ἀ., [[Eph.4.22|Eph.4:22]] pl., ἀπά ται (see M, _Th._, i.e.; _NTD_, 75; MM, l.with): [[2Pe.2.13|2Pe.2:13]] (WH, mg., R., txt., ἐν ἀγάπαις).†
(AS)

G0533.def:
**ἀπ-αρνέομαι** (-οῦμαι) depon.,
[in LXX: [[Isa.31.7|Isa.31:7]] (מָאַס) * ;]
to deny, i.e. to refuse to recognize, **to ignore**: with accusative, of oneself (_DCG_, ii, 598 f.), [[Mat.16.24|Mat.16:24]], [[Mrk.8.34|Mrk.8:34]] (MM, _VGT_, see word), [[Luk.9.23|Luk.9:23]] (WH, mg., txt., ἀρν-) of Peter's denials of Christ, [[Mat.26.34-35, 75|Mat.26:34-35, 75]], [[Mrk.14.30-31, 72|Mrk.14:30-31, 72]], [[Luk.22.34, 61|Luk.22:34, 61]]; pass., [[Luk.12.9|Luk.12:9]] (Cremer, 111).†
(AS)

G0586.def:
**ἀπο-δεκατοω**,
[in LXX for עָשַׂר in both senses foll., e.g. (1) [[Gen.28.22|Gen.28:22]] (2) [[1Sa.8.15|1Ki.8:15]] ;]
1. with accusative of thing(s), **to tithe, pay a tenth of**: [[Mat.23.23|Mat.23:23]], [[Luk.11.42|Luk.11:42]].
2. C. accusative of person(s), **to exact tithes from**: [[Heb.7.5|Heb.7:5]]
3. to decimate (Socr., HE, 573 A; see Kennedy, _Sources_, 117).†
(AS)

G0529.def:
**ἀπάντησις**, -εως, ἡ
(ἀπαντάω), [in LXX chiefly for קָרָא ;]
usually with seel., ὑπ-; a meeting; εἰς ἀ., with genitive or dative, **to meet**: [[Mat.25.6; 27.32|Mat.25:6 27:32]] (WH, txt., omits), [[Act.28.15|Act.28:15]], [[1Th.4.17|1Th.4:17]] (see M, _Th._, in l; M, _Pr._, 14, 242; MM, _VGT_, see word; Lft., _Notes_, 69).†
(AS)

G0519.def:
**ἀπ-άγχω**
(ἄγχω, to press, strangle), [in LXX: [[2Sa.17.23|2Ki.17:23]] (חָנַק), [[Tob.3.10|Tob.3:10]] * ;]
**to strangle**; mid., **to hang oneself** (or, **to choke**; see M, _Pr._, 155): [[Mat.27.5|Mat.27:5]]†
(AS)

G0561.def:
**ἀπ-έναντι **
adv. with genitive (Hellenistic, common in LXX);
1. **over against **(MM, see word): [[Mat.27.61|Mat.27:61]], [[Mrk.12.41|Mrk.12:41]], WH, mg.
2. **before, in the presence of**: [[Mat.27.24|Mat.27:24]] (WH, mg.), [[Act.3.16|Act.3:16]], [[Rom.3.18|Rom.3:18]].
3. **against**: [[Act.17.7|Act.17:7]]†
(AS)

G0509.def:
**ἄνωθεν**
_ adv_ (ἄνω),
(a) **from above**: ἀπὸ ἄ., [[Mat.27.51|Mat.27:51]], [[Mrk.15.38|Mrk.15:38]]; ἐκ τῶν ἄ., [[Jhn.19.28|Jhn.19:28]] meaning, **from heaven**: [[Jhn.3.31; 19.11|Jhn.3:31 19:11]], [[Jas.1.17; 3.15, 17|Jas.1:17 3:15, 17]] .
(b) **from the first, from the beginning**: [[Luk.1.3|Luk.1:3]], [[Act.26.5|Act.26:5]]; whence
(with) **anew, again**: [[Jhn.3.3|Jhn.3:3]], 7, (so most, but see Meyer, in l; cf. Field, _Notes_, 86 f.); πάλιν ἄ., [[Gal.4.9|Gal.4:9]] (MM, _VGT_, see word).†
(AS)

G0577.def:
**ἀπο-βάλλω **
[in LXX: [[Isa.1.30|Isa.1:30]] (נָבֵל) and elsew. without _Heb._ equiv. ;]
**to throw off**: [[Mrk.10.50|Mrk.10:50]] metaphorically, **to lose, let go **(Field, _Notes_, 231 f.; MM, see word): [[Heb.10.35|Heb.10:35]]†
(AS)

G0528.def:
**ἀπαντάω**, -ῶ
[in LXX chiefly for פָּגַע ;]
1. to go to meet.
2. **to meet**; with dative: [[Mrk.14.13|Mrk.14:13]], [[Luk.17.12|Luk.17:12]] (WH, mg., ὑπ-; in Rec. frequently as see1. for ὑπ-, which see).†
(AS)

G0508.def:
**ἀνάγαιον** (Rec. ἀνώγεον; on the form, see Rutherford, _NPhr._, 357 f.; MM, _VGT_, see word), -ου, τό
(ἀνά, γῆ),
**an upper room**: [[Mrk.14.15|Mrk.14:15]], [[Luk.22.12|Luk.22:12]].†
_SYN._: ὑπερῷον (AS)

G0545.def:
**ἀπειθής**, -ές
(πείθομαι), [in LXX for מַרְאָה, מְרִיא, סָרַר ;]
**disobedient**: absol., [[Luk.1.17|Luk.1:17]], [[Tit.1.16; 3.3|Tit.1:16 3:3]]; with dative, [[Act.26.19|Act.26:19]], [[Rom.1.30|Rom.1:30]], [[2Ti.3.2|2Ti.3:2]].†
(AS)

G0583.def:
**ἀπο-γράφω **
[in LXX: [[Jdg.8.14|Jdg.8:14]], [[Pro.22.20|Pro.22:20]] (כָּתַב), I [[Est.8.30|Est.8:30]], [[3Ma.2.29|3Ma.2:29]] [[3Mac.4.14|3Mac 4:14]] [[3Mac.6.34|3Mac 6:34]] [[3Mac.6.38|3Mac 6:38]] * ;]
1. to write out, copy.
2. **to enrol**; mid., **to enrol oneself**: [[Luk.2.1|Luk.2:1]] (M, _Pr._, 162; but. see _ICC_, in l), [[Luk.2.3|Luk.2:3]], 5; pass., [[Heb.12.23|Heb.12:23]] (see reff, see word ἀπογραφή ).†
(AS)

G0582.def:
**ἀπο-γραφή**, -ῆς, ἡ (ἀπογράφω)
[in LXX: [[Dan.10.21|Dan.10:21]] (כָּתָב), I [[Est.8.30|Est.8:30]], AB, [[2Ma.2.1|2Ma.2:1]], [[3Ma.2.32|3Ma.2:32]] [[3Mac.4.15|3Mac 4:15]] [[3Mac.4.17|3Mac 4:17]] [[3Mac.7.22|3Mac 7:22]] * ;]
1. a written copy.
2. As law term, a deposition (Demos.).
3. **In late writers, a register, enrolment, census **(MM, see word; Deiss., _LAE_, 160, 268 f.): [[Luk.2.2|Luk.2:2]], [[Act.5.37|Act.5:37]].†
(AS)

G0576.def:
**ἀπο-βαίνω **
[in LXX for הָיָה, etc. ;]
**to step off, disembark**: [[Luk.5.2|Luk.5:2]], [[Jhn.21.9|Jhn.21:9]]; metaphorically, of events, **to issue, turn out **(Field, _Notes_, 74): [[Luk.21.13|Luk.21:13]], [[Php.1.19|Php.1:19]] (MM, see word).†
(AS)

G0523.def:
**ἀπ-αιτέω**, -ῶ
[in LXX: [[Deu.15.2-3|Deu.15:2-3]], al. (נָגַשׂ), [[Sir.20.15|Sir.20:15]], [[Wis.15.8|Wis.15:8]], al. ;]
**to ask back, demand back**: [[Luk.6.30; 12.20|Luk.6:30 12:20]] (MM, _VGT_, see word).†
(AS)

G0560.def:
**ἀπ-ελπίζω **
[in LXX: [[Isa.29.19|Isa.29:19]] (אֶבְיוֹן), [[Jdt.9.11|Jdth.9:11]], [[Est.4.17|Est.4:17]], [[Sir.22.21; 27.21|Sir.22:21 27:21]], [[2Ma.9.18|2Ma.9:18]] * ;]
1. to give up in despair, despair of (Polyb., Diod., LXX).
2. **to hope to receive from or in return **(Field, _Notes_, 59; Cremer, 712; Soph., _Lex._, see word): with accusative (M; _Pr._, 65; MM, see word), [[Luk.6.35|Luk.6:35]]†
(AS)

G0515.def:
**ἀξιόω**, -ῶ
(ἄξιος), [in LXX chiefly for בְּעָא, בָּקַשׁ; frequently in [[Wis.1.1-16|Wis.1:1-16]], 2 Mac ;]
(a) **to deem worthy**: with accusative and inf. (see MM, _VGT_, see word, and cf. κατ-αξιόω), [[Luk.7.7|Luk.7:7]] id. and genitive of thing(s), [[2Th.1.11|2Th.1:11]] pass. with genitive of thing(s), [[1Ti.5.17|1Ti.5:17]], [[Heb.3.3; 10.29|Heb.3:3 10:29]]
(b) **to think fit**: with inf. (see M, _Pr._, 205), [[Act.15.38; 28.22|Act.15:38 28:22]].†
(AS)

G0588.def:
**ἀπο-δέχομαι **
[in LXX: [[Tob.7.17|Tob.7:17]], [[Jdt.13.13|Jdth.13:13]] [[Jdt.13.1|Jdt.13.1]], [[4Ma.10.1-21|4Mac.10:1-21]] * ;]
**to accept gladly, welcome, receive**: [[Luk.8.40; 9.11|Luk.8:40 9:11]], [[Act.18.27; 21.17; 28.30|Act.18:27 21:17 28:30]]; metaphorically, with accusative of thing(s), [[Act.2.41; 24.3|Act.2:41 24:3]] (MM, see word; Cremer, 688).†
(AS)

G0525.def:
**ἀπ-αλλάσσω **
[in LXX for סוּר hi., etc. ;]
**to remove, release**: [[Heb.2.15|Heb.2:15]] pass., **to depart**: [[Act.19.12|Act.19:12]] in legal sense (MM, _VGT_, see word), before ἀπό, with genitive of person(s), **to be quit of**: [[Luk.12.58|Luk.12:58]] (Cremer, 90, 632).†
(AS)

G0511.def:
**ἀνώτερος**, α, -ον
[in LXX: [[Neh.3.25|Neh.3:25]] (עֶלְיוֹן), [[Ezk.41.7|Eze.41:7]] (מַעַל), [[Tob.8.3|Tob.8:3]] * ;]
only in neut., as adv. (cf. ἐξώτερος),
(a) **of motion, higher**: [[Luk.14.10|Luk.14:10]]
(b) **of rest, above, before**: [[Heb.10.8|Heb.10:8]]†
(AS)

G0535.def:
**ἀπαρτισμός**, -οῦ, ὁ
(ἀπαρτίζω, to finish),
**completion**: [[Luk.14.28|Luk.14:28]] (cf. MM, _VGT_, see word).†
(AS)

G0569.def:
**ἀπιστέω**, -ῶ
(ἄπιστος), [in LXX: [[Wis.1.2; 10.7; 12.17; 18.13|Wis.1:2 10:7 12:17 18:13]], [[Sir.1.27|Sir.1:27]], [[2Ma.8.13|2Ma.8:13]] * ;]
1. **to disbelieve, be faithless**: [[Mrk.16.11, 16|Mrk.16:11, 16]], [[Luk.24.11, 41|Luk.24:11, 41]], [[Act.28.24|Act.28:24]], [[1Pe.2.7|1Pe.2:7]]; so prob. also [[Rom.3.3|Rom.3:3]], [[2Ti.2.13|2Ti.2:13]] (_ICC_, CGT, in ll; MM, see word).
2. = ἀπειθέω (Hdt.; on this sense in Ro, 2Ti, ll. with, see Vaughan on Ro, l.with; Lft., _Notes_, 265; Thayer, see word).†
(AS)

G0507.def:
**ἄνω**
_ adv_ (ἀνά),
(a) **up, upwards**: [[Jhn.11.41|Jhn.11:41]], [[Heb.12.15|Heb.12:15]];
(b) **above **(opposite to κάτω): Act_2:19; with art. ἡ, [[Gal.4.26|Gal.4:26]], [[Php.3.14|Php.3:14]]; τά, [[Jhn.8.23|Jhn.8:23]], [[Col.3.1-2|Col.3:1-2]]; ἕως ἄ. (up to the brim), [[Jhn.2.7|Jhn.2:7]] (Cremer, 106; MM, _VGT_, see word).†
(AS)

G0501.def:
**ἀντλέω**, -ῶ
(ἄντλος, bilge-water in a hold), [in LXX for שָׁאַב, etc. ;]
1. prop., to bale out.
2. **Generally, to draw water**: absol., [[Jhn.2.8; 4.15|Jhn.2:8 4:15]]; ὕδωρ, [[Jhn.2.9; 4.7|Jhn.2:9 4:7]] (on its use of the water made wine, see _DCG_, ii, 815a; MM, _VGT_, see word; Field, _Notes_, 84 f.).†
(AS)

G0502.def:
**ἄντλημα**, -τος, τό
(ἀντλέω),
(a) prop., what is drawn (Diosc.);
(b) **a vessel to draw with, a bucket **(Plut.; see Abbott, _Essays_, 88): [[Jhn.4.11|Jhn.4:11]]†
(AS)

G0584.def:
**ἀπο-δείκνυμι **
[in LXX: [[Est.2.9|Est.2:9]] (רָאָה), al. ;]
1. **to bring out, show forth, exhibit **(Lft., _Notes_, 200; _ICC_, in l): [[1Co.4.9|1Co.4:9]]
2. **to declare, show**: [[Act.2.22|Act.2:22]]
3. **to prove**: [[Act.25.7|Act.25:7]]
4. As frequently in late Gk., **to proclaim to an office**: before ὅτι, [[2Th.2.4|2Th.2:4]] (Milligan, in l; MM, see word; Lft., _Notes_. 113.)†
(AS)

G0546.def:
**ἀπειλέω**, -ῶ (ἀπειλή)
[in LXX: [[Nam.1.4|Nam.1:4]] (גָּעַר), [[Isa.66.14|Isa.66:14]] (זָעַם), [[Sir.19.17|Sir.19:17]], al. ;]
**to threaten**: [[1Pe.2.23|1Pe.2:23]] mid., [[Act.4.17|Act.4:17]] (see MM, _VGT_, see word, and cf. προσαπειλέω).†
(AS)

G0547.def:
**ἀπειλή**, -ῆ, ἡ
[in LXX for גְּעָרָה, etc. ;]
**threatening, threat**: [[Act.4.29; 9.1|Act.4:29 9:1]], [[Eph.6.9|Eph.6:9]].†
(AS)

G0564.def:
**ἀ-περί-τμητος**, -ον
(περιτέμνω), [in LXX chiefly for עָרֵל ;]
**uncir­cumcised**; metaphorically (τ.) καρδίαις (cf. [[Jer.9.26|Jer.9:26]], al.): [[Act.7.51|Act.7:51]] (ἄσημος, found in π., **appears to have been the word used by Greek-speaking Egyptians**: see Deiss., BS, 153; cf. also Cremer, 885; MM, see word)†
(AS)

G0556.def:
**ἀπ-ελαύνω **
[in LXX for נָצַל, שָׁלַח ;]
**to drive away**: [[Act.18.16|Act.18:16]] (MM, see word).†
(AS)

G0557.def:
**ἀπ-ελεγμός**, -οῦ, ὁ
(ἀπελέγχω, to convict, refute),
**refutation, disrepute**: ἐλθεῖν εἰς ἀ., [[Act.19.27|Act.19:27]] (not elsewhere; see MM, see word).†
(AS)

G0503.def:
**ἀντοφθαλμέω**, -ῶ
(ἀντί, ὀφθαλμός), [in LXX: [[Wis.12.14|Wis.12:14]] * ;]
to look in the face, look straight at (Polyb.). Metaphorical, **to face, withstand **(Wis, l.with, Polyb.): with dative, ἀ. τ. ἀνέμῳ, **as nautical term, to beat up against the wind **(see _DB_, _ext._, 366 f.; MM, _VGT_, see word): [[Act.27.15|Act.27:15]]†
(AS)

G0580.def:
**ἀπο-βολή**, -ῆς, ἡ
(ἀποβάλλω);
1. **a throwing away**, **rejection**: opposite to πρόσλημψις, [[Rom.11.15|Rom.11:15]]
2. **a losing**, **loss**: [[Act.27.22|Act.27:22]]†
(AS)

G0553.def:
**ἀπ-εκ-δέχομαι ** depon.,
**to await or expect eagerly **(Lft., _Notes_, 149; MM, _VGT_, see word): absol., [[1Pe.3.20|1Pe.3:20]] C. accusative of thing(s), [[Rom.8.19, 23; 8.25|Rom.8:19, 23 8:25]], [[1Co.1.7|1Co.1:7]], [[Gal.5.5|Gal.5:5]]; with accusative of person(s), [[Php.3.20|Php.3:20]], [[Heb.9.28|Heb.9:28]].†
(AS)

G0536.def:
**ἀπ-αρχή**, -ῆς, ἡ
(ἀπάρχομαι, to make a beginning in sacrifice, offer first fruits) [in LXX chiefly for תְּרוּמָה, רֵאשִׁית ;]
1. the beginning of a sacrifice.
2. **first fruits**: τοῦ φυράματος (cf. [[Num.15.20|Num.15:20]]), [[Rom.11.16|Rom.11:16]]. Metaphorical, ἀ. τοῦ πνεύματος: [[Rom.8.23|Rom.8:23]] of Christians: [[Rom.16.5|Rom.16:5]], 1, [[1Co.16.15|1Co.16:15]], [[2Th.2.13|2Th.2:13]] (WH, mg., R, mg., txt., ἀπ᾽ ἀρχῆς; see Lft., _Notes_, 119 f.), [[Jas.1.18|Jas.1:18]], [[Rev.14.4|Rev.14:4]]; of Christ: [[1Co.15.20; 15.23|1Co.15:20 15:23]] (Cremer, 117; MM, _VGT_, see word).†
(AS)

G0543.def:
**ἀπείθεια**
(WH, -θία, exc. [[Heb.11.1-40|Heb.11:1-40]] with), -ας, ἡ (ἀπειθής), [in LXX [[4Ma.8.9|4Ma.8:9]] [[4Mac.8.18|4Mac 8:18]] [[4Mac.12.4|4Mac 12:4]] * ;]
**disobedience **(MM, _VGT_, see word): [[Rom.11.30, 32|Rom.11:30, 32]], [[Heb.4.6, 11|Heb.4:6, 11]]; υἱοὶ τῆς ἀ. (genitive of definition, see M, _Pr._, 73 f.), [[Eph.2.2; 5.6|Eph.2:2 5:6]], [[Col.3.6|Col.3:6]] (T, WH R, mg., omit).†
(AS)

G0572.def:
**ἀπλότης**, -ητος, ή
(ἁπλοῦς), [in LXX: [[2Ki.15.11|4Ki.15:11]] (תֹּם), [[1Ch.29.17|1Ch.29:17]] (לֵבָב יֹשֶׁר, ἁ. τῆς καρδίας, cf. [[Col.3.22|Col.3:22]], where see Lft.), [[Wis.1.1|Wis.1:1]], al. ;]
**simplicity, sincerity**: [[Rom.12.8|Rom.12:8]], [[2Co.11.3|2Co.11:3]], [[Eph.6.5|Eph.6:5]], [[Col.3.22|Col.3:22]]; as manifested in generous, **unselfish giving, liberality, graciousness**: [[2Co.8.2; 9.11; 9.13|2Co.8:2 9:11 9:13]] (see _ICC_, [[Rom.12.8|Rom.12:8]] Hort, [[Jas.1.5|Jas.1:5]], and see: ἁπλῶς).†
(AS)

G0516.def:
**ἀξίως**,
_ adv._ [in LXX: [[Wis.7.15; 16.1|Wis.7:15 16:1]], [[Sir.14.11|Sir.14:11]] * ;]
**worthily**: [[Rom.16.2|Rom.16:2]], [[Eph.4.1|Eph.4:1]], [[Php.1.27|Php.1:27]]; with genitive (frequently in Inscr.; Deiss., BS, 248; MM, _VGT_, 51), ἀ. τ. Κυρίου, [[Col.1.10|Col.1:10]] τ. θεοῦ [[1Th.2.12|1Th.2:12]], [[3Jn.6|3Jn.6]].†
(AS)

G0585.def:
**ἀπό-δειξις**, -εως, ἡ
(ἀποδείκνυμι) [in LXX: [[3Ma.4.20|3Ma.4:20]], [[4Ma.3.19|4Ma.3:19]] [[4Mac.13.10|4Mac 13:10]] * ;]
1. a showing off.
2. As used by Gk. philosophers, **demonstration, certain proof**: [[1Co.2.4|1Co.2:4]] (see _ICC_, in l; MM, see word; Lft., _Notes_, 173).†
(AS)

G0558.def:
**ἀπ-ελεύθερος**, -ου, ὁ, ἡ
**a freedman**: τ. κυρίου (MM, see word), [[1Co.7.22|1Co.7:22]]†
(AS)

G0550.def:
**ἀπ-εῖπον**, 2 aor. without present in use
[in LXX for מָאַס, אָמַר, etc. ;]
1. to tell out.
2. to forbid ([[1Ki.11.2|3Ki.11:2]]).
3. **to renounce**: 1 aor. mid. (WH, _App._, 164; MM, _VGT_, see word), [[2Co.4.2|2Co.4:2]]†
(AS)

G0526.def:
**ἀπ-αλλοτριόω**, -ῶ
[in LXX for זוּר, H5110 etc. ;]
**to alienate, estrange**; pass.: [[Eph.2.12; 4.18|Eph.2:12 4:18]], [[Col.1.21|Col.1:21]] (MM, _VGT_, see word; Cremer, 95, 633).†
(AS)

G0524.def:
**ἀπ-αλγέω**, -ῶ
1. prop., to cease to feel pain for (Thuc., ii, 61).
2. In late Gk.
(a) **to despair **(Polyb., i, 35, 5);
(b) **to become callous, reckless **(Polyb., xvi, 12, 7; MM, _VGT_, see word): [[Eph.4.19|Eph.4:19]]†
(AS)

G0538.def:
**ἀπατάω**, -ῶ
(ἀπάτη), [in LXX for פָּתָה, נָשָׁא hi., etc. ;]
**to deceive**: with accusative, [[Jas.1.26|Jas.1:26]] with accusative of person(s), dative of thing(s), [[Eph.5.6|Eph.5:6]] pass., [[1Ti.2.14|1Ti.2:14]] (on its infrequency in late writers, see MM, _VGT_, see word; cf. ἐξαπατάω).†
(AS)

G0555.def:
**ἀπ-έκ-δυσις**, -εως, ἡ
(ἀπεκδύω)
**a putting or stripping off**: [[Col.2.11|Col.2:11]] (MM, _VGT_, see word).†
(AS)

G0554.def:
**ἀπ-εκ-δύω **
**to strip off clothes or arms**; mid., **to strip off from oneself**: [[Col.3.9|Col.3:9]] to strip, despoil (mid, for act., _ICC_, in l; but cf. Lft., Ellic.), [[Col.2.15|Col.2:15]]†
(AS)

G0562.def:
**ἀπέραντος**, -ον
(περαίνω, to complete, finish) [in LXX: [[Job.36.26|Job.36:26]] (חֵקֶר אַיִן) 3Mac.20 * ;]
**endless, interminable**: [[1Ti.1.4|1Ti.1:4]]†
(AS)

G0506.def:
**ἀνυπότακτος**, -ον
(ά- neg., ὑποτάσσω) [in Sm.: [[1Ki.2.12; 10.27|1Ki.2:12 10:27]] (for LXX, λοιμός, בֵּן בְּלִיַּעַל)* ;]
**of things, not subject to rule**: [[Heb.2.8|Heb.2:8]] of persons, **unruly**: [[1Ti.1.9|1Ti.1:9]], [[Tit.1.6, 10|Tit.1:6, 10]] (MM, _VGT_, see word).†
(AS)

G0579.def:
**ἀπό-βλητος**, -ον
(ἀποβάλλω), [in Aq.: [[Lev.7.18|Lev.7:18]], al.; Sm.: [[Hos.9.3|Hos.9:3]] (טָמֵא) ;]
**to be thrown away, rejected**: [[1Ti.4.4|1Ti.4:4]] (Hom., Plut.).†
(AS)

G0521.def:
**ἀ-παίδευτος**, -ον
(παιδεύω), [in LXX for כְּסִיל, etc., chiefly in Wis. lit. ;]
**uninstructed, ignorant**: [[2Ti.2.23|2Ti.2:23]]†
(AS)

G0512.def:
**ἀν-ωφελής**, -ές
(ἀ- neg., ὄφελος), [in LXX: [[Isa.44.10|Isa.44:10]] (יָעַל בִּלְתִּי) [[Jer.2.8|Jer.2:8]] (יָעַל לֹא), [[Pro.28.3|Pro.28:3]], [[Wis.1.11|Wis.1:11]] * ;]
**unprofitable**: [[Tit.3.9|Tit.3:9]] neut. as subst., **unprofitableness**: [[Heb.7.18|Heb.7:18]]†
(AS)

G0541.def:
**ἀπ-αύγασμα**, -τος, τό
(αὐγή, brightness, whence ἀπαυγάζω, to radiate or reflect) [in LXX: [[Wis.7.26|Wis.7:26]] * ;]
**of light beaming from a luminous body, radiance, effulgence**: [[Heb.1.3|Heb.1:3]]†
(AS)

G0552.def:
**ἄπειρος**, -ον
(ἀ- neg., πεῖρα, trial), [in LXX: [[Num.14.23|Num.14:23]], [[Zec.11.15|Zec.11:15]] (אֱוִלִי) [[Jer.2.6|Jer.2:6]] (עֲרָבָה) * ;]
**without experience of**: with genitive of thing(s), [[Heb.5.13|Heb.5:13]] (MM, _VGT_, see word).†
(AS)

G0540.def:
**ἀπάτωρ**, -ορος, ὁ, ὴ
(ἀ- neg., πατήρ)
1. fatherless.
2. without father (MM, _VGT_, see word), i.e., **with no recorded genealogy**: [[Heb.7.3|Heb.7:3]]†
(AS)

G0531.def:
**ἀ-παρά-βατος**, -ον
(παραβαίνω),
**inviolable, and so unchangeable**: [[Heb.7.24|Heb.7:24]] (see Westc., in l; Cremer, 653; MM, _VGT_, see word).†
(AS)

G0578.def:
**ἀπο-βλέπω **
[in LXX for פָּנָה, etc. ;]
**to look away from all else at one object; hence, to look steadfastly**: [[Heb.11.26|Heb.11:26]] (cf. ἀφοράω).†
(AS)

G0574.def:
**ἁπλῶς **
_adv._ (ἁπλοῦς), [in LXX: [[Pro.10.9|Pro.10:9]] (תֹּם), [[Wis.16.27|Wis.16:27]], [[2Ma.6.6|2Ma.6:6]] * ;]
**simply, sincerely, graciously**: [[Jas.1.5|Jas.1:5]] ("Later writers comprehend under the one word the whole magnanimous and honour­able type of character in which ... singleness of mind is the central feature "-Hort, _Ja._, l.with)†
(AS)

G0551.def:
**απείραστος**, -ον
(πειράζω for cl. ἀπείρητος, πειράω),
**untempted, untried, without experience**: [[Jas.1.13|Jas.1:13]] (see Hort, in l; MM, _VGT_, see word).†
(AS)

G0581.def:
**ἀπο-γίνομαι (cl. -γίγν-)**
[in LXX: Da TH [[Dan.2.1|Dan.2:1]] * ;]
1. to be away, removed from.
2. **to depart life, to die **(MM, see word): τ. ἀμαρτίαις, i.e. with ref. to sins, [[1Pe.2.24|1Pe.2:24]] (Cremer, 149, 668).†
(AS)

G0500.def:
**άντι-χριατος**, -ον, ό
**Antichrist, "one who assuming the guise of Christ opposes Christ" **(Westc., _Epp. Jo._, 70): [[1Jn.2.18|1Jn.2:18]] [[Jhn.2.22|Jn 2:22]] [[Jhn.4.3|Jn 4:3]], [[1Jn.1.7|1Jn.1:7]] pl. [[1Jn.2.18|1Jn.2:18]] (cf. ψευδόχριστος, and see MM, _VGT_, see word).†
(AS)

G0592.def:
**ἀπο-δι-ορίζω**
(διορίζω, ἅρος, a limit),
to mark off, hence metaphorically to make separations: [[Jude.19|Ju 19]] (Cremer, 806).†
(AS)
